text:
Priya (AE): FYI Mercury Capital asked for a 3-week POC starting next Monday. Scope: SAML SSO (IdP-initiated), SCIM v2 provisioning limited to name/email/manager/AD groups, automated deprovisioning within 24h, role mapping from AD groups to our RBAC, domain ownership proof, cert rotation policy, and an itemized hosted vs dedicated cost comparison. They also want confirmation on audit logs retention and whether we can scrub PII from logs for POC. Need a tight packet for their security team by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (SE): We support IdP-initiated SAML and can accept SAML metadata or raw certs. Cert rotation: recommended cadence is 90 days; we support metadata refresh and can accept a rolling cert swap with zero downtime if they publish both old/new in IdP metadata.

Jon (Solutions Eng): SCIM notes: we do scim v2, accept group->role mapping. For AD groups we usually map external group.displayName -> org_role via a mapping table. Deprovisioning: we can honor the delete operation and queue purge; for Hosted POC we can guarantee logical deactivation within 24h and full data deletion request processed within 5 business days unless they require faster SLA (then add to SOW).

Priya (AE): They specifically asked for a 24-hour hard delete for any user data created during POC. Is that feasible?

Helen (Legal): Hard delete within 24 hours is aggressive. For Hosted we can offer deactivation in 24 hours and commit to deletion within 72 hours for the POC with written SOP. For Private/Dedicated (customer-managed infra) we can do faster on request. Also note export / backup windows may require explicit statement. I'll draft the deletion language.

Liam (SE): Audit logs: we retain request-level logs for 30 days by default, admin audit trail 90 days. We can provide a compressed audit dump for the POC on request. PII scrubbing: we can turn on a PII-filtering pipeline that redacts emails/SSNs from logs, but that will reduce some debug fidelity. Recommend enabling for the POC.

Jon (Solutions Eng): Example SCIM mapping snippet for AD groups -> RBAC (we'll hand this to their IdP team):

```
scim.group_mappings:
  "FinanceAdmins": "org:finance_admin"
  "ModelOps": "org:model_ops"
  "Observers": "org:viewer"
```

Jon (Solutions Eng): Also note we require a stable subject id (immutable) for user records; don't map subject to email if they intend to change addresses.

Todd (Sales Ops): Pricing: I'll draft two line items for the packet: (1) Hosted POC (usage + $Y credit) with support hours bundled; (2) Short-term Dedicated eval (pro-rata for N GPUs + network egress) as an optional upgrade. Need to know expected tokens/day and peak QPS to price Dedicated.

Priya (AE): They estimated 120k tokens/day steady, 600k tokens/day peak, and expect bursts up to 200 RPS during demos. Add that to the quote.

Liam (SE): Network/domain verification: preferred is DNS TXT on the primary domain for ownership proof. Alternate: create a verification email to admin@domain. For tenant isolation proof, we can include a diagram showing logical tenancy (namespace + org-id + token scoping) and an optional Private network diagram (VPC + subnets + security groups).

Helen (Legal): Security pack: we can include SOC2 Type II summary, pen test summary, KMS approach (hosted: Redwood-managed; Dedicated/Private: customer-managed KMS supported), and redacted runbooks. If they request customer-managed keys for the POC, that triggers an addendum. Flag it early.

Priya (AE): They asked if SCIM can be one-way (IdP->Redwood) for POC and later expanded to two-way sync. Confirm?

Jon (Solutions Eng): Yes, we can run one-way provisioning and later enable linkable attributes for two-way sync in Dedicated/Private. We'll document delta resolution rules in the SOW.

Todd (Sales Ops): Action items: I'll prepare the two quote variants and a POC SOW template (goals, success metrics, support windows, deletion SLA). Jon you'll own the SCIM mapping checklist; Liam you'll supply cert rotation and domain TXT sample; Helen you'll draft deletion/legal wording. Priya owns client communication.

deploy-bot: Ticket #INF-502 created to host POC diagram and SCIM sample (expires in 10 days).

Priya (AE): Great. Can everyone drop their deliverables into the ticket by 14:00 PT tomorrow? I'll merge the packet and send to Mercury's security contact. Thanks. :raised_hands:
